title: Deleting Code Without Losing Knowledge: Regenerative Software for Python Libraries
abstract: arXiv:2610.17197v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the age of "Software 3.0", when a complete program can be rewritten in minutes by an agent, the traditional approach of relying on code as the sole source of truth becomes questionable. Fowler advocated for a set of seven primitives, which lay the framework for regenerative software, so that programs can be deleted and rebuilt without losing their knowledge. The knowledge lives in machine-readable records in a tracked directory, from which a *regeneration bundle* is built for each unit. The regeneration bundle is a single file with the module's architecture, intent, decisions, public contract, evaluations, and consumers, but no implementation, plus the one dependency module it may import. The open-source package spotregen implements these primitives and provides a graphical user interface. translated_title: 删除代码而不丢失知识：面向Python库的再生软件
translated_abstract: 在“软件3.0”时代，当智能体可以在几分钟内重写一个完整程序时，依赖代码作为唯一真理来源的传统方法变得值得怀疑。Fowler倡导了一组七种原语，为再生软件奠定了框架，使程序可以在不丢失知识的情况下被删除和重建。知识存储在被跟踪目录中的机器可读记录里，并从中为每个单元构建一个“再生束”。再生束是一个单一文件，包含模块的架构、意图、决策、公共契约、评估和消费者，但不包含实现，外加它可能导入的一个依赖模块。开源软件包spotregen实现了这些原语并提供了图形用户界面。本报告展示了Fowler的原语在安全关键型预测库spotforecast2-safe上的首次应用。在首次实
tldr: 本文首次将Fowler的再生软件原语应用于安全关键型Python预测库，通过机器可读的“再生束”记录架构、意图与契约等知识，使代码可被删除重建而不丢失知识。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first application of Fowler's regenerative software primitives to a safety-critical Python forecasting library, storing knowledge in machine-readable "regeneration bundles" so that code can be deleted and rebuilt without losing knowledge.
